violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. PLEASE ENSURE MORE STAFF OBTAIN A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATION OR THAT STAFF CAN REMAIN ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF FOOD OPERATION.

violations.observation: OBSERVED EXPIRED QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KITS ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
